3 Band Compressor.GainIn: Gain applied to the whole signal before it is split into bands
3 Band Compressor.GainOut: Gain applied to the summed bands at the output
3 Band Compressor.GlobalMix: Sets the balance between the dry signal and the compressed bands
3 Band Compressor.LowMidFreq: Crossover frequency between this band and the one above it
3 Band Compressor.MidHighFreq: Crossover frequency between this band and the one above it
3 Band Compressor.Solo0: Mutes the other bands so only this one is heard
3 Band Compressor.Threshold0: Level above which this band starts being compressed
3 Band Compressor.Ratio0: Sets how strongly this band is compressed above its threshold
3 Band Compressor.Attack0: Time to reach full gain reduction once threshold is crossed
3 Band Compressor.Release0: Time to return to unity once level falls below threshold
3 Band Compressor.Makeup0: Make-up gain applied to this band after compression
3 Band Compressor.Mix0: Sets balance between dry and compressed signal for this band
3 Band Compressor.AutoMakeup0: Adds automatic compensation for this band's gain reduction, on top of its gain

3 Band Limiter.Threshold0: Level above which this band is limited; lower values drive it harder
3 Band Limiter.Margin0: Maximum output level of this band, as the headroom left below 0 dBFS
3 Band Limiter.Release0: Time for band gain to recover after signal falls below threshold
3 Band Limiter.Mix0: Balance between the dry and limited signal of this band
3 Band Limiter.LowMidFreq: Crossover between low and mid bands; above Mid/High, mid band falls silent
3 Band Limiter.MidHighFreq: Crossover between mid and high bands; below Low/Mid, mid band falls silent

3 Band Shelf.FreqLowMid: Crossover frequency between the low shelf and the mid bell
3 Band Shelf.FreqMidHigh: Crossover frequency between the mid bell and the high shelf
3 Band Shelf.GainLow: Boost or cut applied by the low shelf
3 Band Shelf.GainMid: Boost or cut applied by the mid bell
3 Band Shelf.GainHigh: Boost or cut applied by the high shelf

Analog BBD Chorus.Rejection: Anti-alias / reconstruction filter cutoff, in octaves below the clock
Analog BBD Chorus.Depth: Clock deviation applied by the LFO
Analog BBD Chorus.Delay: Centre delay the LFO modulates around
Analog BBD Chorus.Cross: Cross-mix of each channel's wet into the other channel

Analog BBD Delay.BBDSize: BBD stage count, as a power of two
Analog BBD Delay.Blend: Balance between the saturated and clean paths
Analog BBD Delay.Q: Resonance at the filter edge, flat at centre

Analog Chorus.Speed: Rate of the modulation sweeping the delay time
Analog Chorus.Width: Depth of the sweep, also lengthening the base delay
Analog Chorus.Intensity: Amount of feedback, making the effect more pronounced
Analog Chorus.TransientEnhancement: Level of the transient enhancer on the wet signal, keeping attacks defined

Analog Crunch.InputGain: Boosts or cuts the signal feeding the crunch stage
Analog Crunch.Overdrive: Sets how hard the signal is pushed into the saturation curve
Analog Crunch.Trash: Steepens the saturation curve, from rounded knee to squared-off edge
Analog Crunch.Mix: Balance between the clean signal and the crunched signal
Analog Crunch.OutputGain: Level of the module output, after distortion
Analog Crunch.Oversampling: Internal oversampling factor, trading CPU for reduced aliasing

Analog Filter.Q: Emphasis of cutoff; high settings make the filter ring or self-oscillate
Analog Filter.KeyTracking: Filter key tracking relative to C3; tune freq to C3 to follow note
Analog Filter.Mode: Chooses the filter response: low pass, high pass or band pass

Analog Flanger.Speed: Rate of the modulation sweeping the delay time
Analog Flanger.Width: Depth of the sweep, also lengthening the base delay
Analog Flanger.Intensity: Amount of feedback, making the effect more pronounced
Analog Flanger.TransientEnhancement: Level of the transient enhancer on the wet signal, keeping attacks defined

Analog Tape Delay.Trash: Amount of distortion applied to the echoes
Analog Tape Delay.Spread: Stereo width of the echoes, from mono to exaggerated
Analog Tape Delay.Delay: Length of the delay, in milliseconds or bars/beats when tempo-synced
Analog Tape Delay.Feedback: Amount of delayed signal fed back into the delay line
Analog Tape Delay.Wet: Level of the delayed signal at the output
Analog Tape Delay.Dry: Level of the unprocessed signal at the output
Analog Tape Delay.DistortionMode: Style of saturation applied to the echoes: Tape, Tape/Tube or Analog
Analog Tape Delay.InterpolationTime: Time to reach a new delay time; longer gives slower pitch glide

Autopan.Depth: Sets how much of the stereo field each cycle sweeps
Autopan.Speed: Sets how fast one panning cycle completes, in Hz or beats
Autopan.Mode: Chooses the pan law used by the cycle: Linear, Equal-power, Balance or Rotate

Big Pi Tone.Tone: Blends tone circuit from lowpass at minimum to highpass at maximum
Big Pi Tone.Gain: Output level of the tone circuit

Biquad Filter.Mode: Chooses the filter response: high pass, low pass, band pass or notch
Biquad Filter.Q: Emphasis of cutoff; high settings make the filter ring or self-oscillate
Biquad Filter.KeyTracking: Filter key tracking relative to C3; tune freq to C3 to follow note

Bloom.ReverbGain: Output gain of the reverb signal in dB
Bloom.ModDepth: Pitch modulation depth in cents for chorus-like movement
Bloom.ModRate: Speed of the pitch modulation as a multiplier
Bloom.Diffusion: Amount of diffusion applied to smear transients
Bloom.Rise: Controls the bloom envelope rise time as a fraction of decay
Bloom.Width: Stereo width of the reverb output
Bloom.RoomSize: Virtual room size in meters, affects delay lengths and decay
Bloom.DecayTime: Reverb decay time multiplier relative to room size
Bloom.DecayLow: Low frequency decay multiplier relative to main decay
Bloom.DecayHigh: High frequency decay multiplier relative to main decay
Bloom.FreqLow: Crossover frequency between bass and mid decay bands
Bloom.FreqHigh: Crossover frequency between mid and high decay bands
Bloom.Shape: Controls the density distribution of the reverb tail
Bloom.StructuralMode: Reverb network topology: single, parallel, or serial tanks
Bloom.TapoutMode: Controls how delay line taps are mixed for the output
Bloom.Freeze: Freezes the reverb tail in an infinite sustain
Bloom.PreDelay: Initial delay before the reverb onset
Bloom.TapAmount: Blend amount for the selected tapout mode
